sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Tomb of the Spider Queen is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Webweavers. One per lane,
they will fight alongside the team who pays the required amount of Gems,
dealing heavy damage to enemy Structures on their way.

sections.text:

See our Tomb of the Spider Queen Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text:
Here you can find one or more formations
that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane
are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 4-1
Map Strategy
sections.text:
At 0:30 minutes, you could try to sneak-capture the neutral Siege Camp
in the bottom lane with the help of a second Hero that you sent
there beforehand. While doing so, do not play for the allied Bruiser Camp
in the middle lane because they may need your help in the bottom lane.
At 0:30 minutes or right before a team gets Webweavers, start clearing
the allied Bruiser Camp in the middle lane and capture it as soon as possible.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions,
capture it at 1:05 minutes or 5 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
After that, if your team has an advantage,
start clearing the neutral Siege Camp in the bottom lane
and capture it as soon as possible.
When your team has enough Gems, prepare waves to be even vertically
and pay to get Webweavers. When paying, someone should give vision in nearby
bushes so you don't get caught by surprise and lose all your Gems.
When the enemy team has enough Gems, ruin waves to not be even vertically
and stop the enemy Hero who is carrying the highest amount of Gems from paying,
however, be careful not to die in the process because having a numerical
disadvantage will only make defending from Webweavers harder.
After about 10:00 minutes, whenever your team has an advantage
or right after all allied Webweavers have been killed, you can pay Gems and capture
the Boss Camp at the same time by taking aggro
of the Boss while paying the last few Gems, and then push with them.
Avoid doing it earlier if you do not have a dedicated team composition.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Tomb of the Spider Queen has a total of 4 Mercenary Camps:
1 Boss Camp (red icon) in the top lane;
2 Bruiser Camps (blue icon) in the middle lane;
1 Siege Camp (green icon) in the bottom lane.
Mercenary Camps on Tomb of the Spider Queen disappear from the battlefield
once the Webweavers begin spawning (unless their Mercenaries are in combat)
and reappear only after all Webweavers have been killed.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
280 Experience
+4 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them.
These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage.
Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.
Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
4:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
450 Experience
+9 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field
around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range.
Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Boss Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Sand Golem. Once captured,
it spawns the same unit fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with it to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
5:00 minutes
5:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
750 Experience
+10 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
While in combat, the Sand Golem will use Mega Smash (10-second cooldown)
to damage and Stun all enemies in melee range
and Whirling Sands (15-second cooldown) to do slight damage
and Knockback enemies who get hit by them.
Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe
effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Tomb of the Spider Queen consists of 3 Webweavers
that spawn after paying enough Gems. In order to pay, Heroes have to channel for 6 seconds.
Whenever a team pays enough Gems, after a 15-second delay, a Webweaver will spawn in each lane.
Webweavers can use Death Wave (7-second cooldown and 4-second channel), a powerful Ability to deal damage
in front of them, and Spawn Minions (20-second cooldown), which summons 2 Cryptcrawlers.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
30 seconds
15 seconds after the Webweavers die

Collect Gems
Enemy spider minions and Heroes drop magical gems upon death. Gather as many as you can!
Turn in Gems
Relinquish your gems at one of the Spider Queen's altars or you will drop them all when you die!
Summon Webweavers
Whichever team turns in enough gems first will unleash the Webweavers to destroy their enemy's defenses.

sections.title: Gems
sections.text:
You need 50 Gems to pay, plus 5 Gems for each time your team
already got Webweavers during the game. If your team has enough Gems
to pay, the Gems counter (under the Minimap) for your team will glow.
Ranged Minions, Murky, The Lost Vikings, and Misha drop 1 Gem.
All other enemy Heroes drop 3 Gems. Heroes can carry
a maximum of 100 Gems.
Gems are lost on death, but allied Heroes have 8 seconds
to pick them up from the ground before they disappear.
Keep in mind that enemy Heroes can see where they are,
so smart opponents will try to zone you away from them.
Right before winning the Objective, you should ideally prepare waves
so that allied Webweavers reach enemy Structures at the same time in
every lane and thus the enemy team cannot easily defend them one at a time.
Similarly, right before losing the Objective, you can ruin waves
to weaken enemy Webweavers.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text:
Every 5 seconds, the Core will shoot a Death Wave, dealing 5% maximum Health
as damage to enemy Heroes and Slowing them by 70% for 1.25 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text:
To win the game on Tomb of the Spider Queen, you should count on
any of the following win conditions:
Map Objective,
Boss Camp.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text:
On this Map, due to the Objective being always active,
you can use the Healing Fountain on cooldown
instead of saving it for when the Objective spawns.
You do not need to use your Mount while rotating
between the middle and the top lane because they are very close to each other.
Movement Speed effects (notably Crossfade - Speed Boost
by Lucio) help with that.
Every time you have 10 Gems or more, pay to avoid losing them on death.
Gems that fall on the ground and are not collected in time will be lost forever,
causing your team to get fewer Webweavers throughout the game.
You can press Tab to see who has the highest amount of Gems among enemy Heroes.
Use that information to not let that Hero pay while your team does
or to kill them when no other enemy Heroes are nearby to pick up their lost Gems.
If your team has an advantage and enough
Gems to get Webweavers, you can aggro the Boss
while the last few Gems are being paid. By keeping the Boss in combat,
the Boss Camp does not disappear
from the battlefield while Webweavers are alive, so you can
clear it and capture it while Webweavers are spawning and then
push with Webweavers and Boss at the same time.
You can bait the Sand Golem's Whirling Sands on the enemy side of the battlefield
by staying there right before they spawn. This way, if the enemy team invades the
Boss Camp, they will have annoying tornadoes on their path.
See our Map Guides page for further information »
